اجتمرت (form VIII)
# اِجْتَمَرْتُ (ijtamartu) /id͡ʒ.ta.mar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
# اِجْتَمَرْتَ (ijtamarta) /id͡ʒ.ta.mar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
# اِجْتَمَرْتِ (ijtamarti) /id͡ʒ.ta.mar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
# اِجْتَمَرَتْ (ijtamarat) /id͡ʒ.ta.ma.rat/: thi
